Vulcanization

Vulcanization is the process of Cross Linking of Latex Molecules. It is this process that determine the strength and the quality of the glove. The Gloves will be good quality if the cross limking of Latex Molecules is perfect. The Gloves produced by Innovative Gloves Company Limited have extra ordinary physical properties viz Tensile Strength, Ultimate Elongation and Modulus. Our Nitrile Gloves have a Tensile Strength of over 22 MPA After Aging while our Latex Gloves exceed 18 MPA Tensile Strength (A/A).
